title: ai-workload-profile.json — Discover phase AI profile
description: Profile of AI/ML workloads: models, capabilities, integration, and supporting infrastructure. Produced by discover-app-code (code AI confidence >= 70%) OR discover-iac (Vertex-strong IaC, minimal profile), and merged in discover-assemble. FLOOR contract (required structure only; additional properties allowed). CLASSIFICATION rules (capability assignment from data/sdk-capability-map.json, orchestration_pattern/transport/auth_hint evidence tables) live in the discover-app-code prose, NOT this schema. IMPORTANT floor notes: models[] MAY be empty for profile_source 'iac_vertex' (downstream must not assume non-empty); agentic_profile / tool_manifest / current_costs are CONDITIONAL and therefore NOT required (a non-agentic, no-billing profile is fully valid without them); workloads[] is always present (empty array if no AI call sites).

project_directory.description: Absolute path to the analyzed project.

profile_source.description: application_code (full profile from code), iac_vertex (minimal profile from Vertex-strong Terraform only), or merged (code + pre-existing IaC combined).

sources_analyzed.description: Which data sources were provided (affects which sections are populated).

overall_confidence.description: Combined detection confidence from all signals (0.0-1.0).

ai_source.description: Source AI provider. Drives Design's migration-path routing (anthropic → Bedrock Claude, not SageMaker).

inferred_from_iac.description: true when the profile was produced without app-code analysis (IaC-only); false when code drove detection.

models.description: Each distinct AI model/service detected. MAY be empty for profile_source 'iac_vertex' — downstream must not assume non-empty.

service.description: GCP service category (e.g. vertex_ai_generative). NOT service_type/gcp_service.

detected_via.description: Detection sources (e.g. code, terraform). NOT detection_method/source.

capabilities_used.description: Capability strings for this model. NOT capabilities/features.

usage_context.description: Human-readable description of what the model does. NOT description/purpose.

integration.description: How the app connects to AI.

pattern.description: Integration pattern; 'unknown' typical for IaC-only. NOT integration_type/method.

capabilities_summary.description: Boolean map: union of all capabilities across all models. NOT capabilities/feature_flags.

infrastructure.description: Terraform resources related to AI. Empty array if no Terraform was provided.

current_costs.description: CONDITIONAL — present ONLY if billing data was provided; omitted entirely otherwise.

detection_signals.description: Raw AI-detection signals for transparency: method, pattern, confidence, evidence.

workloads.description: Per-workload disambiguation, one entry per unique (model_id, sdk_method, structured_output) tuple. ALWAYS present; empty array if no AI call sites detected.

workload_id.description: Deterministic hash 'wl_' + sha256(model_id|sdk_method|structured_flag)[:6]. Unique within the array. NOT id/name.

model_id.description: MUST exist in models[].model_id. NOT model_name/source_model.

sdk_method.description: Fully qualified SDK method name. NOT method/api_call.

structured_output.description: true iff structured-output indicators detected in call arguments.

file.description: Repo-relative POSIX path (forward slashes, no absolute paths).

agentic_profile.description: CONDITIONAL — present ONLY when agentic signals detected (is_agentic true); omitted entirely otherwise.

is_agentic.description: Always true when this section exists (explicit for downstream gates).

model_id.description: The LLM this agent uses; 'unknown' if not extractable.

tools.description: Tool names; empty array if none.

tool_count.description: Total unique (deduplicated) tools across all agents.

tool_manifest.description: CONDITIONAL — present ONLY when agentic_profile exists. Empty array if agentic but no tools detected. Length MUST equal agentic_profile.tool_count.

name.description: Tool name as defined in code. NOT tool_name/tool_id/id.

transport.description: How the tool communicates. NOT transport_type/type/protocol.

used_by_agents.description: agent_id values referencing this tool; each MUST exist in agentic_profile.agents[].agent_id. NOT agents/consumers.
